nodes.label: Ollama (local LLM runtime)
nodes.rationale: Serves the model locally on localhost:11434; agent.py talks only to it, so the LLM step needs no cloud call. On iOS, the same code works by pointing at a home server LAN IP instead.

nodes.label: Overpass API (OSM POI data)
nodes.rationale: Free OpenStreetMap POI source used by sync_online.py; has fair-use rate limits so sync runs must be kept short.

nodes.label: qwen2.5:1.5b-instruct
nodes.rationale: Fallback model if OOM kills occur: smaller footprint but tool-calling accuracy drops noticeably (magnitude unverified). Swapped in by editing agent.py.

nodes.label: qwen2.5:3b-instruct
nodes.rationale: Chosen because it supports tool-calling reliably at this size (~2GB download). Q4 quantization uses roughly 2-2.5GB RAM, leaving ~5GB for Android + Termux on an 8GB phone. CPU-only inference expected at roughly 3-8 tokens/sec depending on SoC.

nodes.label: Termux Android Setup
nodes.rationale: Install Termux from F-Droid (Play Store build is deprecated/broken), copy folder via termux-setup-storage, run setup_termux.sh, then run 'proot-distro login ubuntu -- ollama serve' in one tab and 'python agent.py' in another.

nodes.label: Tool Calling
nodes.rationale: The agent's mechanism for invoking capabilities in tools.py; model selection is driven by tool-calling reliability at small parameter counts.

nodes.label: Ubuntu-in-proot
nodes.rationale: Used because no native Android Ollama binary exists; running Ubuntu under proot inside Termux is the standard workaround to host Ollama on-device.

nodes.label: 8GB Phone Optimization Notes
nodes.rationale: Memory budget: Q4 3b model ~2-2.5GB RAM leaving ~5GB for OS; drop to 1.5b on OOM. CPU-only 3-8 tok/s rough range, not a spec. SQLite DB is KBs. Keep sync_online.py runs short due to Overpass fair-use rate limits.

nodes.label: iOS Remote-Ollama Path
nodes.rationale: No Termux equivalent exists on iOS (Apple sandboxing). a-Shell/iSH cannot run Ollama reliably under usermode x86 emulation - not recommended. Realistic path: run Ollama on a home server/laptop and reach it over local wifi/Tailscale; same code since agent.py just calls localhost:11434 - repoint to the LAN IP. Explicitly flagged as NOT phone-offline.

nodes.label: cached_data/ (POI/transit/weather cache)
nodes.rationale: Local cache directory refreshed by sync_online.py; the sole data source for offline replanning.

nodes.label: Replanning on Disruption
nodes.rationale: Handles place shut, transport cancelled, weather - offline, using whatever was cached during the last sync_online.py run. Quality depends on cache freshness; agent surfaces staleness so the user can trust it accordingly.

nodes.label: transit.json cache
nodes.rationale: Cache format is defined but NOT auto-populated: no single free API covers Indian intercity transit broadly, so the user must plug in their own transit API/data source or populate it manually before a trip.

nodes.label: Offline Trip Agent
nodes.rationale: A local AI agent (Ollama + tool-calling) that runs fully offline on a phone for itinerary management, budgeting, contact tracking and last-minute replanning from cached data. Explicitly does NOT book, fetch live prices, or know real-time transit status because that requires a network call at that moment.

nodes.label: Cache Freshness / Staleness Reporting
nodes.rationale: Because offline replanning uses cached data, the agent tells the user how stale the cache is via get_cache_freshness so advice can be trusted proportionally rather than presented as live truth.

nodes.label: CLI via Termux (no native Android app)
nodes.norm_label: cli via termux (no native android app)
nodes.rationale: Kept as CLI because a proper Android app (Kotlin + llama.cpp via JNI) is a much bigger build; offered as an alternative if requested.

nodes.label: No Live Booking/Payment (by design)
nodes.rationale: Correctly excluded: you do not want an LLM autonomously spending money, and it is out of scope for 'offline' anyway.

nodes.label: Offline Execution Model
nodes.rationale: Three tiers: (1) itinerary CRUD, budget, contacts are 100% offline and always work; (2) replanning on disruption is offline but only as good as the cache from the last sync_online.py run, and the agent reports staleness via get_cache_freshness; (3) live prices/bookings/availability require a network call, period - refresh cache whenever there is signal.

nodes.label: discovered_places table
nodes.rationale: Staging table for LLM-extracted candidate places with status 'pending'; nothing moves to the itinerary until the user approves.

nodes.label: Discovery Agent (hidden gems)
nodes.rationale: Run 'python discover.py <place>' when online. Fetches Reddit (r/IndiaTravel, r/india, r/backpacking) and YouTube content, caches raw text, then the LOCAL Ollama model (not a cloud call) extracts candidate lesser-known places into discovered_places with status 'pending'.

nodes.label: Reddit Public .json Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Public read-only, no login - fine for personal/prototype use. Script sleeps between requests to avoid hammering; for sustained use register a proper Reddit API app.

nodes.label: YouTube Data API v3
nodes.rationale: Official API requiring YOUTUBE_API_KEY env var; free default quota allows only ~1 search/day.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-loop Discovery Approval
nodes.rationale: Nothing gets added to the itinerary automatically. The offline agent checks get_pending_discoveries, shows candidates, and only calls approve_discovery after the user explicitly says yes - guards against the LLM autonomously mutating the trip plan.

nodes.label: Itinerary CRUD, Budget and Contacts
nodes.rationale: Fully offline capabilities: pure local SQLite state, no network dependency.

nodes.label: trip.db (SQLite database)
nodes.rationale: Tiny (KBs) SQLite file holding itinerary/budget/contacts state; no storage concern on an 8GB phone.
